metadata.title: Trustworthy AI

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability asserting that artificial intelligence systems are governed, controlled, and operated in a trustworthy and accountable manner.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Artificial intelligence, agentic systems, research AI platforms, and AI-enabled decision support systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that all required AI governance, safety, security, and accountability patterns are in place.

metadata.remarks: Trustworthy AI is a composite pattern asserting that AI systems are identifiable, governed, safe to operate, resistant to abuse, and accountable to human oversight. This pattern introduces no independent controls and may be asserted only when all referenced AI capability patterns are implemented.

components.title: AI Core
components.description: Definition, scope, trust boundaries, and AI-native threat anchoring.

components.title: AI Identity and Access
components.description: Identity, authentication, and authorization for AI systems, models, and agents.

components.title: Accountability and Oversight
components.description: Assignment and enforcement of human accountability and governance authority.

components.title: Decision Authority and Human Reliance
components.description: Governance of AI decision authority and constraints on human reliance and automation bias.

components.title: Agentic Behavior Governance
components.description: Controls governing autonomous and semi-autonomous AI actions.

components.title: Context and Tooling Security
components.description: Security of model context, prompt injection prevention, and structured tool invocation.

components.title: Model Lifecycle Governance
components.description: Versioning, promotion, monitoring, and retirement of AI models.

components.title: Training and Derived Data Protection
components.description: Protection of training datasets and AI-derived artifacts such as embeddings and checkpoints.

components.title: Inference Protection
components.description: Protection of AI inference interfaces from abuse, extraction, and economic harm.

components.title: Output Validity and Uncertainty
components.description: Controls mitigating hallucination, false confidence, and misuse of AI-generated outputs.

components.title: Bias and Explainability
components.description: Detection of bias, fairness risks, and provision of explainability and transparency.

components.title: AI Telemetry and Observability
components.description: Visibility into AI inputs, decisions, actions, and agent interactions.

components.title: AI Semantic Data Loss Prevention
components.description: Protection against inferential, generative, and semantic leakage of sensitive information.

components.title: Misuse and Abuse Detection
components.description: Detection and containment of harmful, dual-use, or policy-violating AI usage.

components.title: Economic and Resource Protection
components.description: Protection against cost-based attacks, resource exhaustion, and denial-of-wallet.

components.title: Knowledge Decommissioning
components.description: Safe retirement and removal of AI-retained knowledge and downstream dependencies.

components.title: Agent Interconnection and Delegation
components.description: Governance of agent-to-agent trust, delegation, and transitive risk.

components.title: AI Incident Response
components.description: Response to AI-specific incidents including epistemic harm, unsafe autonomy, and cascading failures.

components.title: AI Red Teaming and Evaluation
components.description: Continuous adversarial testing and evaluation of AI systems over time.
